capabilities: Convert LF to CRLF when copying selected text on Windows
Handle copy buttons in code blocks
Preserve copy-current-line behavior when no text is selected
disambiguation: It does not reformat or convert the Markdown files themselves; it only changes line endings of text at the moment it is copied.
extras: Windows-only by default, with plans for other platforms, configurable line-ending styles, a settings UI, and command palette support listed as future work.
motivation: The author notes that Obsidian's cross-platform LF convention breaks pasting into older Windows apps, and wanted a fix that converts line endings only at copy time so files stay clean and portable.
problem: Obsidian uses LF line endings everywhere, so text copied on Windows can appear squashed into one line in older Windows applications that expect CRLF.
summary: Windows-only plugin that converts LF line endings to CRLF when text is copied from notes, leaving stored Markdown files unchanged.
